mapper.select: SELECT menu_id::TEXT AS row_id, p_menu_id, area, menu_nm, menu_desc, ordr, conn_ty, conn_id, link_url, target_yn, use_yn, icon FROM t_menu WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND area = #{area} AND p_menu_id = #{pMenuId}::integer AND menu_nm LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%' ORDER BY ordr LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_menu WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND area = #{area} AND p_menu_id = #{pMenuId}::integer AND menu_nm LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_auth a JOIN t_auth_user u ON u.authgrp_id = a.conn_id AND u.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN t_menu m ON m.menu_id = a.menu_id AND m.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE a.auth_gbn = 'GRP' AND a.menu_yn = 'Y' AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.user_id = #{userId} AND m.link_url = #{linkUrl}

SELECT menu_id::TEXT AS row_id, p_menu_id, area, menu_nm, menu_desc, ordr, conn_ty, conn_id, link_url, target_yn, use_yn, icon FROM t_menu WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND area = #{area} ORDER BY p_menu_id, ordr
SELECT menu_id::TEXT AS row_id, p_menu_id, area, menu_nm, menu_desc, ordr, conn_ty, conn_id, link_url, target_yn, use_yn, icon FROM t_menu WHERE menu_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_menu ( p_menu_id, area, menu_nm, menu_desc, ordr, conn_ty, conn_id, link_url, target_yn, icon, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip ) VALUES ( COALESCE(NULLIF(#{pMenuId}, '')::integer, 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{area}, ''), 'ADM'), #{menuNm}, #{menuDesc}, -- 같은 영역·부모 내 마지막(사용중) 순서+1로 자동 부여(빈 그룹은 1부터 시작) (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordr), 0) + 1 FROM t_menu WHERE area = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{area}, ''), 'ADM') AND p_menu_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{pMenuId}, '')::integer, 0) AND use_yn = 'Y'), COALESCE(#{connTy}, 'MENU01'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{connId}, '')::integer, 0), #{linkUrl}, COALESCE(#{targetYn}, 'N'), NULLIF(#{icon}, ''), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_menu SET area = #{area}, menu_nm = #{menuNm}, menu_desc = #{menuDesc}, conn_ty = #{connTy}, conn_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{connId}, '')::integer, 0), link_url = #{linkUrl}, target_yn = #{targetYn}, icon = NULLIF(#{icon}, ''), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE menu_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.select:
SELECT menu_id::TEXT AS row_id, ordr FROM t_menu WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND area = #{area} AND p_menu_id = #{pMenuId}::integer
AND ordr < #{ordr}::integer ORDER BY ordr DESC
AND ordr > #{ordr}::integer ORDER BY ordr ASC
LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_menu SET ordr = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{ordr}, '')::integer, 0), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE menu_id = #{rowId}::integer

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT menu_id FROM t_menu WHERE menu_id = #{rowId}::integer UNION ALL SELECT m.menu_id FROM t_menu m JOIN descendants d ON m.p_menu_id = d.menu_id ) UPDATE t_menu SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE menu_id IN (SELECT menu_id FROM descendants)

UPDATE t_menu SET ordr = ordr - 1, upd_dt = NOW() WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND area = (SELECT area FROM t_menu WHERE menu_id = #{rowId}::integer) AND p_menu_id = (SELECT p_menu_id FROM t_menu WHERE menu_id = #{rowId}::integer) AND ordr > (SELECT ordr FROM t_menu WHERE menu_id = #{rowId}::integer)
